featured.name: Poorvi Pramod Jain
featured.text: I had a very positive experience getting my cavity treated by Dr. Nikhil Jain. He was calm, professional, and explained the entire procedure clearly, making the treatment smooth and comfortable. The clinic was clean and hygienic, and the staff was warm and friendly. Highly recommend!

featured.name: KANAN SHAH
featured.text:
Had a great experience with Dr. Nikhil Jain at Arha Dental Care for my dental implant treatment
The dentist was professional, gentle, and explained everything clearly. The clinic was clean and well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The treatment was handled with great care, making the whole experience comfortable and reassuring. Highly recommended for quality dental care!

featured.name: Anand Kothari
featured.text: Had taken my father to Dr. Nikhil at Arha Dental Care. Dr. Nikhil was very polite and explained every step while he was treating my father. The new clinic is very clean and hygienic and updated with new equipments. Thank you Dr. Nikhil for making my father comfortable. Would definitely recommend my family and friends to visit Arha Dental Clinic when needed.

featured.name: Suchita Kothari
featured.text:
Took my 4-year-old son to Arha Dental Care for his annual check-up and cleaning and the experience was excellent. Dr. Nikhil was calm, gentle and quick. The entire process was smooth, and my son didn’t cry or fuss at all, which says a lot about how comfortable he felt.

The clinic is modern, spotless, and equipped with the latest technology. What I appreciate most is that Dr.Nikhil is equally wonderful with patients of all ages. From my 70-year-old mother to my 4-year-old son, our entire family trusts him with our dental care. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a skilled, caring, and trustworthy dentist.

featured.name: Rajnikant Shah
featured.text:
I have been visiting Dr. Nikhil Jain for many years now, and I recently visited his clinic, Arha Dental Care, at Doctor House, Peddar Road. What has stood out the most about Dr. Nikhil is his focus on patient comfort.
He has a conservative approach to dentistry. He takes the time to explain exactly what he is doing in detail and makes sure all your doubts are addressed before moving forward.
The clinic itself is newly redone and features modern equipment. Having an in house CT scan machine makes the whole diagnostic process much easier.
I highly recommend him for any dental treatments.

featured.name: Shefali Mehta
featured.text: I visited Arha Dental Care for a routine teeth cleaning and had a very positive experience. Dr. Nikhil Jain took the time to explain my oral health using the iTero scanner, which helped me better understand my teeth alignment and gum condition. The consultation was informative, and I also received practical advice on improving my daily oral hygiene. Overall, a professional and educational dental visit.

featured.name: Varsha Jain
featured.text: I’ve always been a little nervous about dental treatments but Dr. Nikhil makes every visit comfortable and stress-free. He is patient, gentle and takes the time to answer all my questions. The clinic is well-maintained and the care I have received has been excellent. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for a dentist who genuinely cares about his patients.

featured.name: Prerit Jain
featured.text: I started my aligner treatment about two years ago and honestly couldn’t be happier with the results. Dr. Nikhil took the time to explain every step of the process clearly before we even began, which made me feel really confident about moving forward. What I loved most were the video follow-ups. Such a convenient way to track progress without having to come in every single time, especially since I’m currently residing in the United States. If you’re considering aligner treatment, I’d highly recommend Arha Dental Care.
